violations.text: No person in charge was certified in food safety as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026
Allery statement was lacking near the self service area. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026
The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety with RIDOH. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026

Eggs and cream cheese was observed held at 46-48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, product was recently moved to location. Product relocated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the mini refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026
The mini fridge located in the area was not in good repair. Unit to be serviced before use. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. The person in charge was unable to provide proof that the establishment has a certified food safety manager. Please email proof of certification or enroll additional employees in a food safety course. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2024

Thermometers are lacking in the mini refrigeration unit(s) near the buffet. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2024
